releaseNotesEmpty: This version has no release notes
releaseNotesUnavailable: Failed to load the release notes
releaseNotesTimeout: Timed out loading the release notes
packageUnavailable: Failed to load the bazaar package info
preferredSourceTip: Which source the changelog dialog opens with. Release notes are listed per version; CHANGELOG reads the CHANGELOG.md file in the repository. If the preferred one is unavailable, this open switches to the other.
githubAccelerationTip: When off, only api.github.com is requested. When on, release notes requests go through the acceleration URL below.
githubAccelerationURLTip: A prefix proxy prepended to the original URL, for example https://gh-proxy.com/ . Left empty or not an http(s) URL, it is ignored.
debugModeTip: Print complete plugin logs to the console.
